FIR Filed Against BJP Members After Congress Chief's Rally in Bengaluru

An FIR has been registered in Bengaluru against members of the Uttarakhand BJP and others in connection with a purification ritual allegedly conducted after a rally addressed by Congress President Mallikarjun Kharge. The complaint states that Kharge participated in and addressed a public meeting at the Ramlila Maidan in Haldwani, Uttarakhand, on August 8. The rally was described as a peaceful and democratic public gathering. The FIR is a 'zero FIR', meaning it can be filed in any jurisdiction regardless of where the offense occurred.
